chunks.title: Hyderabad Fast Express Delivery (1 to 3 Hours)
chunks.content: For customers in Hyderabad (including Boduppal, Uppal, Secunderabad, Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kukatpally, LB Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, etc.), orders are dispatched immediately via Rapido Bike Delivery and Uber Connect packages. Delivery time is usually within 1 to 3 hours from dispatch, and live driver contact details are provided upon dispatch.

quick_answer.en:
🚀 **Hyderabad Express Delivery (1 - 3 Hours):**
We dispatch via **Rapido Bike & Uber Connect** across Hyderabad!
• **Speed:** Doorstep delivery within **1 to 3 hours**!
• **Live Tracking:** Driver contact and live tracking shared as soon as dispatched.
• **Rates:** Fair standard distance rates.
quick_answer.te:
🚀 **హైదరాబాద్ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్ డెలివరీ (1 - 3 గంటల్లో):**
హైదరాబాద్ పరిధిలో **రాపిడో & ఉబర్ కనెక్ట్** ద్వారా 1 నుండి 3 గంటల్లోనే సేమ్ డే ఫాస్ట్ డెలివరీ చేయబడుతుంది!
quick_answer.hi:
🚀 **हैदराबाद एक्सप्रेस डिलीवरी (1 से 3 घंटे):**
हैदराबाद में **रैपिडो और उबर कनेक्ट** से सिर्फ 1-3 घंटे में आपके घर तक डिलीवरी उपलब्ध है!

chunks.title: All-India Courier Shipping (Outside Hyderabad)
chunks.content: For orders outside Hyderabad across India, items are safely packed in multi-layer bubble wrap and rigid corrugated boxes, then shipped via trusted express couriers like DTDC and Blue Dart. Delivery transit time is 2 to 4 business days. Tracking numbers are sent via WhatsApp and SMS upon shipment. Shipping rates are calculated affordably by package weight, and bulk return gift orders qualify for free delivery.

quick_answer.en:
🚚 **All-India Express Courier (2 - 4 Days):**
Shipped via **DTDC & Blue Dart** with multi-layer protective packaging.
• **Delivery Window:** 2 to 4 business days nationwide.
• **Tracking:** Real-time tracking link sent to your phone/WhatsApp.
• **Free Delivery:** Available on wholesale bulk return gift orders!
quick_answer.te:
🚚 **ఆల్ ఇండియా కొరియర్ సర్వీస్ (2 - 4 రోజులు):**
DTDC మరియు Blue Dart ద్వారా భారతదేశం అంతటా 2-4 రోజుల్లో సురక్షితంగా డెలివరీ చేస్తాము. బల్క్ ఆర్డర్లపై ఉచిత డెలివరీ లభిస్తుంది!
quick_answer.hi:
🚚 **अखिल भारतीय कूरियर (2 से 4 दिन):**
DTDC और Blue Dart द्वारा 2-4 दिनों में सुरक्षित रूप से ऑल इंडिया डिलीवरी। थोक ऑर्डर पर फ्री डिलीवरी उपलब्ध है!

Customers simply send an unboxing photo or video to our official WhatsApp (+91 75693 04410), and our team immediately dispatches a brand new replacement unit or processes a direct refund without hassle.

chunks.title: Payment Options & Security
chunks.content: We accept all major payment modes: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Debit/Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), Net Banking across all Indian banks, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible areas. WhatsApp order confirmation and UPI QR code payments are also supported with 100% end-to-end security and instant receipt generation.

quick_answer.en:
💳 **Accepted Payment Methods:**
• **Instant UPI:** Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM.
• **Cards & Net Banking:** Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking.
• **Cash on Delivery (COD):** Available for local Hyderabad and select pin codes.
• **WhatsApp Direct:** Confirm order and pay via UPI QR code on WhatsApp.

💳 **పేమెంట్ పద్ధతులు:**

chunks.title: Material Quality, Authenticity & Child Safety
chunks.content: All items sold at Jaya Jaya Varahi Shop follow strict quality and safety standards: (1) Pure Brass Pooja Items & Diyas are cast with heavy-gauge, durable brass and hand-finished with traditional antique luster. (2) Handcrafted Wooden Toys are made from natural wood with rounded edges and painted with non-toxic, child-safe vegetable/organic dyes. (3) Stainless Steel Cookware utilizes food-grade Tri-Ply construction with a heavy aluminum core for uniform heat distribution on both induction and gas stoves.

quick_answer.en:
✨ **Quality & Material Authenticity:**
• **Pure Brass Diyas & Decor:** Heavy-gauge, hand-carved pure brass with lasting antique finish.
• **Wooden Toys:** 100% natural wood, smooth splinter-free rounded corners, non-toxic organic vegetable dyes safe for kids.
• **Tri-Ply Cookware:** Premium food-grade 3-layer steel with induction and gas compatibility.

• ఇండక్షన్ మరియు గ్యాస్ రెండింటికీ సరిపోయే ప్రీమియం స్టెయిన్‌లెస్ స్టీల్ కుక్‌వేర్.

chunks.title: How to Place an Order Step-by-Step
chunks.content: Placing an order is easy: (1) Browse items and click 'Add to Cart'. (2) Open your Cart using the Cart button in the header. (3) Click 'Proceed to Checkout', choose Hyderabad or Outside Hyderabad delivery, enter your delivery address and contact phone. (4) Click 'Place & Confirm Order' to finalize your order with instant order ID generation and WhatsApp confirmation.

quick_answer.en:
🛒 **How to Order in 4 Easy Steps:**
1. Browse products and tap 'Add to Cart'.
2. Click the Cart button in the top navigation bar.
3. Click 'Proceed to Checkout', pick *Hyderabad (1-3 hrs)* or *Outside Hyderabad (Courier)*, and enter address.
4. Tap 'Place & Confirm Order'!
quick_answer.te:
🛒 **ఆర్డర్ చేసే విధానం:**
1. నచ్చిన వస్తువుపై 'Add to Cart' క్లిక్ చేయండి.
2. కార్ట్ ఓపెన్ చేసి 'Proceed to Checkout' నొక్కండి.
3. మీ అడ్రస్ ఎంటర్ చేసి ఆర్డర్ కన్ఫర్మ్ చేయండి!

1. 'Add to Cart' पर क्लिक करें।
2. कार्ट खोलकर 'Proceed to Checkout' पर जाएं।
3. अपना पता भरकर 'Place & Confirm Order' दबाएं!
